{{Quote|Munch-fungus can be eaten raw. While it has a bland taste to it, Twi'leks know how to season and cook it to satisfy a variety of palettes.|[[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]]|<ref name="Platt's Starport Guide" />}}
'''Munch-fungus''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of edible [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] people. One of several fungal strains that contributed to the traditional diet of the indigenous Twi'leks, munch-fungus was a versatile [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that could be eaten raw or cooked in a variety of culinary dishes. Possessed of a naturally spongy consistency and bland flavor, munch-fungus could nevertheless be prepared and [[Spice/Legends|seasoned]] to suit a multitude of tastes, especially by an experienced cook.<ref name="Platt's Starport Guide" />

When ground into a fine powder, combined with [[Water/Legends|water]], and kneaded into dough, munch-fungus could be baked into loaves of [[Bread/Legends|bread]]. Regarded as tasty, [[munch-fungus bread]] could be kept in reserve for many [[Standard day/Legends|days]] without spoiling. Raw munch-fungus could be served in a soaking bowl of warm [[Soup/Legends|broth]], and the [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as [[Mal'aa's Kitchens]] often provided munch-fungus broth as an accompaniment to [[rycrit stew]]. The cantina's owner, a matronly Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Mal'aa]], was also willing to teach even the most inexperienced cooks to properly prepare meals using munch-fungus.<ref name="Platt's Starport Guide" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], two Twi'lek brothers [[Currency/Legends|sold]] a wide selection of local fungi in the [[City/Legends|city]] of Kala'uun. Along with [[Glow-fungus|glow-]] and [[burn-fungus]], the brothers harvested munch-fungus from the lower caverns of Kala'uun in large quantities, bringing daily cartloads of their fungal goods into the city every morning. Commonly known as the "[[Fungus Brothers]]," the siblings typically sold munch-fungus for two [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per handful.<ref name="Platt's Starport Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Munch-fungus was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|''Star Wars'' roleplaying game]] book ''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] [[1995]].<ref name="Platt's Starport Guide" />
